title: Bind model-consuming startup and run the sequential BackgroundPhotoWorker

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Model-admitted runtime tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_background_worker_runtime.py tests/processing/test_model_asset_admission.py

verify.summary: Fresh independent T3 verification on the exact current immutable image passed packaged mypy, the 11-case model-admission/restart suite, a verifier-owned direct Buffalo M admission/no-fallback probe and Memory Bank lint. Active plus queued Photos survived process replacement, recovered exactly one unfinished row and converged to two idempotent ready results; both roles admitted only matching committed assets and failed closed before readiness/work for missing, ineligible or mismatched cases. Cleanup left zero task databases, MinIO objects and one-off containers. Executor evidence remained supporting-only.

Fresh independent T3 verification on the exact Attempt 2 image passed packaged mypy, 13 focused admission/restart/runtime tests, verifier-owned committed-switch and loop-supervision probes, fresh direct Buffalo admission and Memory Bank lint. An A-bound process stopped claiming after B commit with both rows unchanged; the B-bound replacement alone published one ready result. Worker-loop failure cleared readiness and terminated the lifecycle. Ordinary restart and all matching/fail-closed model-admission claims remained green. Cleanup left zero task databases, MinIO objects and one-off containers; Attempt 1 evidence remained historical/supporting.

Execution Attempt 1 adversarial verification reproduced two material supported-path breaks: after the committed selection changed from A to B, the stale A-bound worker claimed and terminally failed B work; separately, a runtime claim exception killed the sole worker loop while health remained ready until lifespan exit. No operator ambiguity remained, and cleanup left zero task databases and containers.

Execution Attempt 2 adversarial reassessment confirmed both prior findings resolved: after B commit, the A-bound worker made five no-op claims with both rows unchanged and zero inference or writes, while only the B-bound replacement reached ready. Loop exception and unexpected return both cleared readiness, marked worker-loop failure and terminated lifespan. No material finding or question remained, and cleanup left zero task databases and containers.

evidence_required: FT-002-AC-003 RED: the current BackgroundPhotoWorker entrypoint does not recover or execute the durable Photo population; GREEN: a real task-owned worker process restart during active plus queued work preserves every Photo, resets unfinished work, restarts from the original and reaches one idempotent terminal result per row; decisive comparison: pre/post population IDs, recovery facts, attempt counts, face/derivative cardinality and terminal states all match; artifact: redacted worker-process transcript and disposable PostgreSQL/MinIO projection.

REQ-SRCH-001 via .memory-bank/domains/photo-processing.md#model-asset-admission RED: the current worker/realtime composition roots expose fake or unadmitted startup without selected-revision model mounts; GREEN: matching read-only fixtures make both roles resolve the committed validated revision, instantiate only its direct adapter and verify the full immutable identity plus computed weights_sha256 before recovery/readiness, while missing, absent/ineligible, identity/hash-mismatched and other-pipeline fixtures keep the role unavailable with zero work/state mutation; decisive comparison: per-case exit/readiness, loaded pipeline identity, recovery/claim/inference observations and processing-state snapshots; artifact: redacted Compose/process transcript and disposable PostgreSQL/model-fixture projection.
purpose: Bind both model-consuming composition roots to the committed validated revision before readiness/work, then connect startup recovery and one-at-a-time Photo orchestration to the real BackgroundPhotoWorker process without introducing selection or scheduler infrastructure.
success_outcome: Worker and realtime start only with matching read-only assets for the committed validated revision; the worker then preserves queued and active Photo work across process restart and converges on idempotent terminal outcomes.
anti_goals: Do not add multiple workers, a broker, jobs table, leases, fencing, priority/preemption, watchdog or durable replay beyond Photo state.
Do not move model-selection, inference or worker business logic into an entrypoint, infrastructure adapter or backend process.
Do not add model download, fallback, registry, adapter factory, cache, hot switch, automatic rollback or simultaneous dual-pipeline preload.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004; only startup model admission/readiness binding is in scope here
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: The configured process cannot run one sequential loop through the processing application boundary.
Restart correctness requires another durable queue, coordination service or production-state probe.
Worker and realtime cannot share the accepted model-admission contract without adding another selection policy, runtime mechanism or FT-004 query behavior.

constraints: The composition roots own only lifecycle and deployment binding: serving_control owns committed revision selection and processing owns model identity verification, adapters, inference and worker state.
One operator-managed host model directory is mounted read-only into background-worker and realtime; assets are not embedded in the image, persisted in PostgreSQL or downloaded at runtime.

Each role resolves the committed selected validated revision, instantiates only that direct adapter and verifies revision/pipeline code, detector and recognizer IDs/versions, preprocessing/alignment/normalization versions, embedding dimension and computed weights_sha256 before readiness, recovery, claim, inference or processing-state mutation.
A serving-revision change takes effect only after the operator updates assets/settings as needed and restarts both model-consuming roles.
Runtime proof uses unique disposable PostgreSQL rows and MinIO prefix, known initial state, safe rerun and confirmed cleanup.
Restart only task-owned worker/realtime processes against deterministic fixtures; do not access production deployment, model assets or data.
invariants: Exactly one configured worker operation runs at a time.
Both model-consuming roles bind only the committed validated revision and remain unavailable on any missing, ineligible or mismatched asset/configuration.
No fallback pipeline, download, registry/factory, hot switch or dual preload exists.
Unfinished processing returns to pending and begins again from the immutable original.
Realtime work, Calibration computation and hard purge are not implemented or replayed here.
verification_targets: Deterministic read-only fixture matrix proves both roles load only the committed matching revision; missing, absent/ineligible, full-identity/hash-mismatched and other-pipeline assets fail closed before recovery/readiness/work with unchanged revision and state until explicit restart.
Real process restart with active plus queued disposable work records population identity, recovery projection, eventual terminals, one face set and zero task-owned residue.
